notes.title: Update
notes.notes: The entire Heroes Rise Series has been updated to include more gender options, including both transgender and nonbinary options. So, whether you're beginning your story anew in Heroes Rise: The Prodigy, you're joining America's #1 super powered reality TV show in Heroes Rise: The Hero Project, or you're fighting the powers that be in Heroes Rise: HeroFall, you'll now be able to do it as yourself.
